# BuildKit test fixtures

Test data from [moby/buildkit](https://github.com/moby/buildkit) v0.26.1
(`frontend/dockerfile`, Apache License 2.0).

- `parser/`: verbatim copies of `parser/testfiles`, `parser/testfiles-negative`
  and `parser/testfile-line`. Each `result` is the `Node.Dump()` output of the
  upstream parser.
- `shell/envVarTest.env.json`: the Unix/All lines of `shell/envVarTest` with
  the upstream expectations verbatim (`TestShellParser4EnvVars`: the
  environment is `PWD=/home SHELL=bash KOREAN=한국어 NULL=`, unset variables
  expand to an empty string).
- `shell/`: the inputs of `shell/wordsTest` and `shell/envVarTest` with
  expectations generated by the upstream lexer in its variable-preserving
  mode (BuildKit's `SkipUnsetEnv` with an empty environment), which is how
  this lexer behaves without an `env`:

  ```go
  lex := shell.NewLex('\\')
  lex.SkipUnsetEnv = true
  lex.RawQuotes = rawQuotes // wordsTest.rawQuotes.json
  env := shell.EnvsFromSlice(nil)
  word, _, err := lex.ProcessWord(input, env)
  words, err := lex.ProcessWords(input, env)
  ```

  `ProcessWords` upstream loses the text before a `${VAR<modifier>...}`
  expression (`he${XXX:-000}xx` → `${XXX:-000}xx`): the nested
  `processStopOn` call for the modifier resets the shared words buffer. The
  `words` of those `envVarTest.json` entries are the intact words, the
  upstream output is kept as `buildkitWords`.
